text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a new year ripe with opportunity for Agnes Digital to go big.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: By the way, how was your year-end haul? Get any good, uh, "reading materials"?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh… never mind… We haven't known each other for even a year yet, so I guess I shouldn't be sticking my nose into your business.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But, let's make it a goal to be able to talk about our favs by the, uh, "summer market." What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure what she means by "reading materials" and "markets," but I smile and nod.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: For now, let's reflect on the previous year and make plans for this one. Last year, I stepped onto the stage of my dreams—the Twinkle Series…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I really got ahead of myself though, huh? I have to remember the whole reason I came here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: It's time to get back in touch with the fundamentals. I must obey the commandments!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Umamusume are goddesses! Thou shalt not intrude upon them! Especially when it comes to racing conversations.
choice_data_list: Are you thinking about what happened with Meisho Doto?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Well… yeah. No matter how you look at it, I totally committed a transgression…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Instead, I… I ought to just accept all Umamusume as they are! I want to support them no matter their situation!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: That's my rule…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems the difference in her social standing between now and before she debuted is still somewhat unclear to her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …Which means that while I will strive to do my best in my races this year, I also need to get back to pure, proper, unobtrusive simping.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Umamusume sure are great, huh? So, the first thing I want to do this year is reaffirm how amazing they are!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But I'm not sure exactly how I should go about it. Do you have any recommendations?
choice_data_list: Let's do something to serve Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, acts of service! Good idea. And this is the perfect chance since everyone's on break!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry and go purify the grounds before a certain someone gets there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As soon as we reach the training center, Agnes Digital sets about fervently sprucing up the dirt track.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… I think that should do it. Looks much easier to run on now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Now I can only pray that it'll benefit my precious Uma's training.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that you, Digital? What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: S-Scarlet… Um, I was just taking a walk is all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah. That's good to hear. I was worried someone had beaten me at being the first to train this year.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, I'm going to go get a run in.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: O-okaaay! Have a safe run!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whew, I'm glad I made it in time. I figured she would come here before New Year's break finished.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: With this, I'm sure she'll have a comfortable run. Nice job, me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having predicted that Daiwa Scarlet would come, Agnes Digital successfully manages to do a good deed for an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Reading… Yeah, that could be nice… and I know just where to find a treasure trove of Umamusume goodness.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Or not… 'cause the library's a bust! They don't really carry what I'm looking for…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Actually, I already have the largest collection of Umamusume literature in my room. With that said, see ya!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm gonna spend this New Year's with my nose buried in all the fan comics I just got.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hm, which one should I start with? Maybe a silly four-panel anthology? Or maybe this other one here…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Actually, no. This one miiight be too intense to start the new year. I just know it's gonna have me obsessed with tags I never knew existed. I need something tamer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, Agnes Digital lounges around her dorm casually reading through her collection of fanfics.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Imitation, huh? Yeah, I can honor my oshis with my body instead of just my heart. Let's try it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that decided, Agnes Digital and I head to the training center.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer. Be sure to take it all in. I'm gonna show you an impersonation performance to remember.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: First up, the Teio Step!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Next, Palmer's explosive front running! BFFs! Hurdle run! Yeaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to how avidly she watches her cherished Umamusume, she's good at impersonating others. She might be able to put this to good use in her races.
